dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is coherent: audit and maintain machine-facing entity identity, Knowledge Graph facts, sameAs links, Wikidata identifiers, disambiguation, and recognition evidence.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The main instructions define clear boundaries, require user authorization before persistent writes, and route page-level AI-citation or brand-canon work to other skills; one reference includes broader GEO/content advice, but it is guidance rather than automatic action.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Artifacts are markdown-only skill and reference files; no executable install scripts, package hooks, obfuscation, or automatic network execution were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Reads and writes are proportionate to a registry-based entity optimizer: it reads entity memory/projections and source evidence, then writes authorized events through a registry runtime when available.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill can persist canonical entity events when the host grants the entity-optimizer capability, but it discloses this, requires explicit authority, uses event append flows, and forbids direct edits to canonical files or recreating erased person records.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: The GEO-style tactics reference does reach beyond the strict registry boundary, but the primary skill contract explicitly excludes page-level AI-citation work and points that work to a separate skill, so this is a scope-hygiene note rather than a security concern.
[SDI-1] expected: Knowledge Panel and Wikidata guidance is broadly aligned with entity optimization; it may involve public profile or knowledge-base updates, but the artifact frames changes as sourced, user-directed work and includes conflict-of-interest and notability cautions.
llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to audit and maintain machine-readable entity identity records. Review any proposed persistent registry writes, Wikidata/profile changes, or natural-person records before approval, and keep page copy or broader GEO content work in the separate skills named by this package.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed entity-identity auditing skill with bounded registry writes and no evidence of hidden or destructive behavior.
